name: smwsprites-princess-peach
title: Princess Peach
description:
This is a disassembly of sprite 7C in SMW, Peach as she appears after you defeat Bowser.

Besides Peach herself, this sprite also handles things like the "Mario's adventure is over..." message and the fireworks sequence, as the original did. Works best with sprite memory 00, or 10 with the No Sprite Tile Limits patch.
